answer: Locks are written down in crystal, expire in opal, and echo lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 100 aliases therefore needs 103 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 39 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
